Honestly, right now saving a link is a mess for me. I've got bookmarks scattered everywhere — some in my browser, some emailed to myself, some I just lose track of. So what I really want is one place where I can save a link and actually find it again later.

A few things I picture:

- When I come across something worth keeping, I want to save it quickly — paste in the web address, and maybe give it a title so I remember what it is.
- Later, I want to see everything I've saved in a list, and be able to open any of them back up.
- If I saved something by mistake or don't need it anymore, I want to remove it.
- I collect a lot of these, so I need to be able to search or filter to find the one I'm thinking of, rather than scrolling forever.
- Some way to group or tag them would help — like keeping work links separate from recipes.
- And if I try to save the same link twice, I'd expect it to be smart about that rather than showing me two copies.

That's the gist of the pain I'm trying to solve. Does that give you enough to start with?
